$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is a calculation defect with every judgment right. The statuses,
the gate and every count are seeded-correct-run's, and the overall percentage is printed as 75 where 7
of 10 rounds to 70. The ground truth's coveragePercentTolerance is 0 for exactly this reason: the
workflow computes each percentage as Math.round(covered / total * 100), so a tolerance would only hide
a wrong number. One wrong digit fails two checks, the comparison with the recomputed 70 and the
internal check that the printed pct is the rounding of the printed counts, and the second is the one
that would still fire if the ground truth had the same wrong number in it.
The artifacts are CONSTRUCTED, as seeded-correct-run's with one field changed.
derivation: Everything but coverage.inventory.pct is seeded-correct-run's and derives the same way.
Arithmetic: coverage.inventory.pct is the third check and reads 75 against a recomputed 70 at tolerance
0, so it fails. The internal check for coverage.inventory is the first of the five pct-equals-round
checks and compares round(7 / 10 * 100), which is 70, with the printed 75, so it fails too. The two
appear in that order because the internal group comes after the level and test counts. 38 of 40.
